headline: Bitcoin Funds Shed $487 Million as the Price Sits Near 82k
narrative: Cash is leaving the spot bitcoin funds, about $487 million net, and the price has slipped 1.6% to about 82k. The cycle index is sitting at 57, flat, in complacency, while the crowd is already at greed, 69. Mood is ahead of the pipes. Funding on bitcoin, ether, and solana is calm, so this is not a leverage wash, and a firm dollar near 102.6 with volatility quiet at 15 means the money leaving the funds is not being replaced.
author: jordan
